row.proto: void Career_Calendar_AdvanceDays(void *clock_owner, uint16_t days, uint8_t flag_mask, char skip)
row.notes: myteam-g2: Advances the My Team career calendar: for each day adds 0x5a0 (1440 minutes) to the clock at owner+0x2b0, computes the new day record (clock>>5 / 0x2d = day number, FUN_141284580), stores it via owner+0x278 vtable +0x200 and posts the day-advanced message (type 0x1456c5718). Loop stops when the session vtable +0x208 reports false. Hook: calling this (or editing owner+0x2b0) moves career time forward; used by Career_TeamHqAdvance_AdvanceOneDay.

verify.notes: V9015 Loop per day: owner+0x2b0 += 0x5a0, day number (clock>>5)/0x2d, FUN_141284580, stored via owner+0x278 vtable +0x200, message 0x1456c5718 posted; loop continues while the vtable +0x208 result is true. Extra detail: advancing only happens when skip==0 and (~state & flag_mask)==0, and a final message 0x1456c5708 with the day number is posted after the loop.
